meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能操控真实浏览器替你完成网页操作(比如打开页面、点击填写、截图),并返回执行结果;浏览器页面会一直保留,连续任务不丢状态。
howto.when: 当用户要求做网页相关操作时触发,比如访问网址、点击或填写页面内容、截图;说 “go to [url]”“click on” 等指令也算。

say.text: 打开 example.com,帮我截一张整页截图
say.note: 会开一个新页面,把截图保存到本机

say.text: 用我登录好的 Chrome 打开购物车页,读出商品列表
say.note: 会用扩展模式连接你现有的浏览器来操作

say.text: 把这个搜索页前两页的链接抓出来
say.note: 会执行网页抓取并把结果返回给你

howto.what_en: Claude can drive a real browser to execute web tasks you ask for (open a page, click/fill, screenshot, etc.) and return the result. Browser pages are kept open across steps, so multi-step work keeps its state.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for browser-related work, such as visiting a site, clicking/filling content, or taking screenshots; commands like “go to [url]” and “click on” also trigger it.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a full-page screenshot.
say_en.note: Creates a new page and saves the screenshot locally.

say_en.text: Open the cart page in my logged-in Chrome and list the items.
say_en.note: Uses Extension Mode on your existing browser.

say_en.text: Extract the links from the first two pages of this search.
say_en.note: Runs the scraping flow and returns the links.
